text:
Asha Patel: Heads-up — Kundr wants to change billing entity to "Kundr EU S.à r.l" and add +50 seats before renewal. Procurement asked for an updated quote and a new PO. Need legal to confirm e-sign authority for the new entity. Can someone advise on required docs? :wave:

Mike Chen: What's the renewal effective date and preferred payment term? Also, will they pay via PO+wire or CC? Pricing impact depends on proration.

Jordan Lee: For an entity swap we need a signed addendum + one of: (1) board resolution, (2) delegation letter on company letterhead, or (3) recent invoice showing billing entity. Our DocuSign template `entity_change_addendum_v2` requires signer name/title and email. If they plan to delegate signing, include a delegation letter. If procurement contact will sign, we need verification of authority (email domain + copy of delegation).

Rachel Gomez: FYI — PO must include EU VAT ID for the EU entity. If they submit a PO, ensure vendor code maps to the EU bank. Wire instructions differ per entity. If they choose CC, we'll process under hosted billing. Also: if their DocuSign is behind SSO, the signer email must match the PO contact.

Asha Patel: Renewal date is 2026-05-15. Customer wants seats effective 2026-04-01 and billed on the next invoice (monthly billing). They prefer PO + wire. I'll ask for VAT ID and a delegation letter today and confirm the exact signer.

Jordan Lee: Uploaded the addendum template: https://redwood-internal/templates/entity_change_addendum_v2.docx — Asha, send me the signer's full name/title/email so I can pre-fill the envelope. Note: if they request a term change (9mo vs 12mo) or a retroactive discount, Pricing needs to approve before we finalize.

DocuSignBot: Template tpl_9523 created and attached to the draft envelope (internal id: env_7782).

Mike Chen: Pricing note — for +50 seats mid-term with monthly billing starting 2026-04-01 we'll prorate April based on days remaining. If they want the bundle discount applied retroactively, we need a written approval from Sales Ops. What SKU are they adding?

Asha Patel: Got it. I'll collect VAT ID, delegation letter, PO, and the signer's name/title/email and confirm the SKU. Will loop in Pricing if they ask for a non-standard discount. Targeting to send the DocuSign envelope by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
